contexts.name: ci-success
contexts.notes: The single mandatory gate job that depends on test and integration-proofs.

contexts.name: test
contexts.notes: Includes mix test (11 docs-contract lanes), format, hex.build, compile --warnings-as-errors, docs, credo, dialyzer. Viewer-evidence schema/lint folded here per Phase 68 D-18 — not a separate required context. Public-api contract lane added Phase 79 D-07.

contexts.name: integration-proofs
contexts.command: mix test --include live_signing test/rendro/adapters/signing_live_test.exs && mix test --include live_pdf_tools test/rendro/adapters/signing_live_test.exs && mix run scripts/release_preflight_proof.exs --current-version-tag --worktree <isolated>

advisory_contexts.name: advisory-checks
advisory_contexts.command: mix test --include live_pdf_tools test/rendro/adapters/forms_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs test/rendro/adapters/embedded_files_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs test/rendro/adapters/links_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs test/rendro/adapters/protection_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs test/rendro/adapters/signature_widget_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs test/rendro/adapters/signed_artifact_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs test/rendro/adapters/trust_sensitive_viewer_evidence_live_test.exs && mix test --include raster_snapshot test/rendro/adapters/pdfium_raster_snapshot_test.exs && mix rendro.launch_artifacts.check && mix rendro.comparison.check && mix rendro.livebook.check && npm ci --prefix scripts/pdfjs_observer && node scripts/pdfjs_observer/observe.mjs --check
advisory_contexts.notes: Combined advisory checks including viewer-evidence-live-proof, raster-advisory, comparison-advisory, livebook-advisory, and pdfjs-advisory. Not required on main. D-32 and REF-03 apply.
